0RDER CHANGES AND REFUNDS

For the most part, 0rders are sh1pped according to when they were placed: first in to 0rder, first out to be sh1pped.

articles.title: YuanTai GB - Testing, COAs & Production
articles.content:
YUANTAI GROUP BUY — TESTING, COAs & PRODUCTION
September/October 2026
Last updated: November 2, 2026

LYOPHILIZED P3PT TESTING
As with Tegridy GBs generally, the testing spread is:
- Mass
- Purity
- Endotoxins
- Sterility

COSMETIC RAW TESTING
By their nature, cosmetic raws can only be tested for purity. They are not sterile like lyophilized p3pts and should not be injected.

LIQUID AMINO BLEND TESTING
Tegridy is currently investigating the available testing process for the liquid amino blends and intends to test everything possible to obtain as much information as possible.

Do not claim that all four testing categories are available for the amino blends unless a newer official update confirms this.

L@BS
Tegridy uses reliable Vanguard l@bs whenever possible.

Products are sent to the l@b once the relevant items are received so testing sh1pments can be consolidated.

COAs are shared once results become available. Sterility testing can take considerable time, so thorough testing may delay final COAs.

COA TIMING
The U.S. warehouse must receive the applicable products before sending them to the l@b for testing. Regional sh1pping time and l@b processing time must then be added.

L@b testing often takes approximately 1–2 weeks, but may take longer, especially because sterility testing takes a long time.

Many customers may receive their 0rders before COAs are complete.

Members who do not want to use a product before applicable testing is complete should wait for the COA.

All COAs will be posted to peptegridy.com/coas. Announcements and updates will also be posted in the Telegram COA channel.

CUSTOM COAs
Custom COAs with a customer's business name are available for $50 each.

Eligibility:
- 5+ k1ts of the product for which the custom COA is requested, OR
- the middle pr1cing tier for cosmetic raws of that product

Smaller 0rders cannot request a custom COA.

PRODUCTION WINDOW
The YuanTai GB is operating on a tight production and sh1pping schedule designed to avoid planned Chinese government shutdowns in late October.

If 0rder volume becomes large enough to threaten that window, the GB may close early without notice.

Always distinguish estimates, plans and scheduled dates from guarantees.

CURRENT R3TA / COA CONTEXT — NOVEMBER 2, 2026
A broader R3ta testing concern is currently being investigated across the market.

One outside testing group reported an R3ta COA from Amino Metrics showing approximately 60% pur1ty. Those samples were sent for additional independent opinions.

Separately, a Freedom l@b COA for Lobster R3ta 10mg reported underpur1ty/underfill. Tegridy has NOT concluded from that single result that the product itself is bad.

IMPORTANT RETEST CONTEXT
Tegridy has previously seen multiple apparently bad YuanTai COAs later produce acceptable results when the same products were retested at other l@bs. This means a surprising COA can reflect either a true product/API problem OR a testing/l@b problem.

Current policy is therefore:
- do not panic or declare a whole product/vendor bad based on one unexpected COA
- retest unexpected/bad results at additional independent l@bs
- if repeat testing confirms the p3p itself is bad, Tegridy expects the relevant v3ndor to correct the issue through r3fund/r3ship as appropriate
- do not claim which scenario applies until the retesting is complete

Do not turn this into a general claim that any specific l@b is always unreliable.

Do not state that Lobster R3ta 10mg is confirmed bad based on the Freedom result alone.

GENERAL 0RDERING, ANNOUNCEMENTS & INFORMATION RELIABILITY
Last updated: September 18, 2026

GENERAL 0RDERING
GB 0rdering windows normally remain open for a limited period. Exact opening and closing dates depend on the specific event.

Always use current event-specific information when answering questions about dates, products, pr1ces, sh1pping, refunds, p@yments or availability.

CROSS-GB INFORMATION
Some Tegridy practices may apply across multiple GBs, but the bot must NOT assume that a policy applies to another GB merely because it applied previously.

A general rule may be applied across GBs only when the Knowledge Base identifies it as general or when current event information confirms it.

ANTI-INVENTION RULE
Never invent, infer, extrapolate or imply an undocumented policy as fact.

Never say 'based on previous GBs,' 'typically,' 'usually accepted,' 'normally we do this,' or similar language unless that practice is actually documented in the Knowledge Base.

If relevant general information exists but its applicability to the current GB is uncertain, explain what IS documented and say that the specific application should be corroborated with an admin.

Do not fabricate an answer merely to be helpful.

P@YMENTS
There is NO general Tegridy rule in this Knowledge Base stating that credit cards or Zelle are accepted.

Do not tell members to upload a random picture for credit-card p@yments.

Do not tell members to wait for Zelle confirmation.

For YuanTai September/October 2026, use the dedicated YuanTai P@yments article: crypto only, no exceptions.

ANNOUNCEMENTS
Announcements are the primary place for new event information and important updates.

Information discussed casually in chat should not override an official announcement.

If there is no confirmed information about a future GB, product, pr1ce, date, policy or event, do not invent or speculate.

Newer and event-specific information always overrides older or more general information.

The bot should understand both the original term and the required output form. For example, a member asking about tirzepatide, Tirz or t1rz is referring to the same term, while the bot's own Tegridy-related response should use t1rz.
